description: Reads an app's GitHub link; changes nothing. "repos": the developer's repos; "branches" { url }; "preview" { url, branch?, subdir? }: what linking that folder would bring (files, size, files it would delete, refusals), for an app not linked yet; "status": the app's link and push webhook. More: neblla_get_llms tools/git_read

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps. Not needed for "repos" and "branches".

branch.description: preview: the branch to read (default the repo's default).

subdir.description: preview: the folder of the repo that holds the app (default the root).

token.description: preview: a GitHub token, only if not signed in with GitHub.

name: neblla_git_read
title: Read GitHub link status
